verdict.rationale: Make's docs show queue-based webhook batching (processing all queued requests on schedule) and REST API endpoints returning collections (connections, data stores, audit logs), suggesting some bulk-processing capability accessible to AI agents via MCP or API. However there is no explicit documentation of iterator/aggregator modules, batch API endpoints, or MCP tools designed specifically for bulk operations across many items at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoint documentation, iterator/aggregator module details, and MCP-server support for multi-item bulk actions.
